# Meals on wheels driver schedule

Valley Senior Meals delivers hot lunches to homebound seniors on weekdays. Its drivers pick up meals at the Grange kitchen at 10:30 and finish their routes by 1:00. The program asked to post a driver recruitment flyer at every branch, and staff agreed.

The meal service is not connected to the library, and library staff should not share patron addresses with it. Seniors who ask about meals can call the program office.
